entities.name: Akul
entities.description: A scorpion dragon outlaw from Gastal, leader of the Hellspurs.

entities.name: Tommy
entities.description: Annie Flash's nephew, poisoned by Akul.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: Legendary treasure vault at the center of Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: Town Akul built around the vault.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Fae shapeshifter thief leading a gang.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker, Oko's disguised benefactor who took treasure from the vault.

events.summary: Akul's gang kills courier Archie Dixon and two guards seeking the final key piece, which is not there.
events.quote: killing a courier named Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards

events.summary: Oko's gang is captured at Tarnation and Akul takes the final key piece, completing the key.
events.quote: completing the true key to Maag Taranau

events.summary: Kellan challenges Akul to a duel.
events.quote: Akul was challenged to a duel by Kellan

events.summary: Sterling mercenaries attack Tarnation and Oko steals the key.
Akul is defeated by Rakdos at the vault; Oko opens it for Jace, who takes treasure and planeswalks away.
events.quote: with Akul being defeated by Rakdos

events.summary: Kellan mind-controls Akul into the vault, which rockets into the sky with him inside.
events.quote: ordering him to walk into the vault and never leave.

relations.quote: He was the leader of the Hellspurs .
the scorpion dragon spent weeks tracking them down
he built the town of Tarnation around the vault
Kellan fully awoke his fae magic and submitted Akul to mind control
